title: Relying-Party Warranty and Site Seal by Certificate Product
content:
Each Harborline product of SSL/TLS Certificates carries the relying-party warranty of the issuing certificate authority and a site seal matching its validation level. This trust-mark sheet lists both for every product.

| Certificate product | Relying-party warranty of the issuing CA (USD) | Site seal provided |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 10000 | DV seal |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 50000 | DV seal |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 250000 | DV seal |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 1000000 | OV seal |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 1000000 | OV seal |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 1750000 | EV seal |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 1750000 | EV seal |

## Comparing the products

- The three DV products carry the DV seal, with warranties of USD 10000, 50000 and 250000 respectively.
- The two OV products carry the OV seal and a warranty of USD 1000000 each.
- The two EV products carry the EV seal and a warranty of USD 1750000 each.

**Which product carries the largest warranty?** The Harborline EV Single Domain and the Harborline EV Multi-Domain, at USD 1750000 each.

**Does a wildcard product carry a different seal from the single-domain product of the same level?** No. The Harborline DV Wildcard carries the DV seal like the other DV products, and the Harborline OV Wildcard carries the OV seal like the Harborline OV Single Domain.
